name: io.github.ghcpuman902/tfl-ts
title: tfl-ts
description: Read-only Transport for London data: line status, arrivals, journeys, stop lookup.

environmentVariables.name: TFL_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: TfL API primary key. Live tools need it. Static tools (docs, resolve_line_id, get_supported_modes) do not.

environmentVariables.name: TFL_MCP_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between outbound TfL requests. Default 250. Cache hits do not count.
